_doc: RP2040 errata per datasheet section 13. Each entry lists the subsystem affected, severity, a detection heuristic the Errata Checker agent can match against, and the published workaround.

errata.title: USB device enumeration fails without reset sequence
errata.description: Under some host timings the USB device fails to enumerate unless the boot ROM reset path is invoked before enumeration completes.
errata.workaround: Use pico-sdk >= 1.4.0 which applies the boot reset workaround automatically.

errata.title: SPI BUSY bit de-asserts one cycle early
errata.description: The SSPSR.BSY bit clears one SCLK cycle before the final bit is shifted out, so polling BSY to detect transfer completion can race.
errata.workaround: Insert a small busy-wait (1 SCLK period) after BSY clears, or use DMA and wait on the DMA transfer-complete IRQ instead.

errata.title: ROSC phase control register undocumented bits
errata.description: Bits 4..7 of ROSC_PHASE are reserved and must be written as zero to avoid undefined oscillator phase.

errata.title: IC_TX_ABRT_SOURCE is cleared by reading IC_CLR_TX_ABRT, not IC_CLR_INTR
errata.description: Reading IC_CLR_INTR does not clear TX_ABRT_SOURCE; callers must read IC_CLR_TX_ABRT explicitly after an abort.
errata.workaround: After detecting a TX abort, read IC_CLR_TX_ABRT before attempting the next transfer.

errata.title: Brief glitch on pad function reassignment
errata.description: Changing GPIO function via FUNCSEL while the pin is driven can produce a sub-microsecond glitch on the pad.
errata.workaround: Disable output (OE=0) before changing FUNCSEL when glitches are unacceptable.

errata.title: PWM counter stalls at TOP when CSR.PH_CORRECT changes mid-count
errata.description: Toggling phase-correct mode while the counter is non-zero causes a one-period stall.
errata.workaround: Disable the slice (CSR.EN=0) before changing PH_CORRECT, then re-enable.

errata.title: XIP cache returns stale data after flash program without flush
errata.description: The XIP cache does not snoop flash writes. Reads from flash immediately after a program/erase may return pre-write values.
errata.workaround: Call flash_range_erase/program from RAM and flush the XIP cache (xip_ctrl_hw->flush = 1) before resuming execution from flash.

errata.title: UART DMA TX completion IRQ fires before final byte leaves shift register
errata.description: The DMA completion IRQ fires when the last byte is written to UARTDR, not when the shift register has emptied.
errata.workaround: Wait on UARTFR.BUSY=0 after the DMA completion IRQ before asserting RTS or powering down.
